Fix uniqueValues(values) in index.mjs: it must return a new array containing the first occurrence of each value, in input order, using SameValueZero equality (NaN equals NaN, and -0 equals 0). Objects compare by identity. Do not mutate the input. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Fix chunks(values, size) in index.mjs so it returns consecutive arrays of at most size items, including the final partial chunk. An empty input returns []; size must be a positive integer or throw RangeError, even when values is empty. The input array must remain unchanged and each returned chunk must be a new array. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Fix clamp(value, min, max) in index.mjs. For finite numbers with min <= max, return value if within the inclusive bounds, min if below, and max if above. A zero bound is a real bound. There is no need to validate inputs outside this stated domain. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Fix parseAssignments(lines) in index.mjs. Each string containing '=' is split at its first '=' only; trim whitespace from the key but preserve the value exactly, including further '=' and whitespace. Skip lines without '=' or whose trimmed key is empty. Return a Map from keys to string values; the last occurrence of a repeated key wins. An empty value is valid. Do not mutate lines. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Fix mergeIntervals(intervals) in index.mjs. Inputs are arrays [start,end] of finite numbers with start <= end. Return their sorted union, merging overlaps and intervals that touch at an endpoint. Keep disjoint intervals separate. An empty input returns []. Never mutate the input array or its pairs, and do not share returned pairs with input pairs. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Fix median(values) in index.mjs. Values are finite numbers. Return their numeric median (the middle sorted number for odd lengths, or the arithmetic mean of the two middle numbers for even lengths). Return null for an empty array. Do not change the input array. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Fix pickOwn(record, keys) in index.mjs. Return a new ordinary object containing only requested keys that are own properties of record, including own properties whose value is undefined. Inherited properties must be excluded. keys contains only ordinary string field names (no '__proto__'). Preserve references to field values and do not mutate either input. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Fix totalQuantity(items) in index.mjs. Each item may omit quantity; only an absent or undefined quantity defaults to 1. Zero, negative, and fractional numeric quantities are used as given. The input contains no null or nonnumeric quantities. Sum all items, returning 0 for none, without mutating the array or its items. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Add exported groupBy(values, keyOf) to index.mjs. Return a Map whose keys come from keyOf(value, index), and whose values are new arrays of matching original values. Keep first-seen key order and input order within each group. Call keyOf exactly once per value, including its zero-based index. Keys may be any JavaScript value and use Map equality. Empty input returns an empty Map; do not mutate values. Keep the existing count export. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Add exported integerRanges(values) to index.mjs. Input is an array of safe integers. Return sorted inclusive [start,end] pairs for maximal runs of consecutive integers, discarding duplicates. For example [5,2,3,3,8] becomes [[2,3],[5,5],[8,8]]. Empty input returns []; do not mutate values. Keep isInteger's existing behavior. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Add exported movingAverage(values, width) to index.mjs. For finite-number input, return averages of each full consecutive window of width values, in order; do not include partial windows. Return [] when width exceeds the input length. width must be a positive integer or throw RangeError, including for empty input. Do not mutate values; ordinary floating-point arithmetic is fine. Keep mean's existing behavior. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Add exported zipLongest(left, right, fill = null) to index.mjs. Return pairs up to the longer array's length, preserving input order; use fill only for indices beyond an array's length. An existing undefined element stays undefined. Both arrays are dense and must remain unchanged. Return [] for two empty arrays. Keep zipShortest's existing behavior. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Add exported partition(values, predicate) to index.mjs. Return [matched, unmatched], two new arrays containing the original values in input order. A truthy predicate result means matched; call predicate(value, index) once per value with its zero-based index. Do not mutate values. Empty input yields [[],[]]. Keep select's existing behavior. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Add exported wordCounts(text) to index.mjs. Words are maximal runs of ASCII letters A-Z or a-z; punctuation, digits, underscores, and non-ASCII characters are separators. Count case-insensitively using lowercase keys in a Map, preserving the order of each word's first appearance. Empty or separator-only text returns an empty Map. Reuse or preserve the existing words export, which returns those lowercase tokens. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Add exported fillTemplate(template, fields) to index.mjs. Replace each token of the exact form {name}, where name matches [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*, when fields has an own property of that name, with String(fields[name]). Leave unknown tokens unchanged. Replacement text is literal (dollar signs have no special meaning) and is never processed again. Inherited fields must not be used. Other braces remain as they are; do not mutate fields. Keep hasField's behavior. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Add exported topScores(items, limit) to index.mjs. Each item has a finite numeric score. Return a new array with at most limit original items ordered by descending score; ties keep input order. Do not mutate the array or its items. limit must be a nonnegative integer or throw RangeError, even for empty input; limit 0 returns []. A limit beyond the input size returns all items sorted. Keep maxScore's existing behavior. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Refactor cheapestActive(items) in index.mjs to find the result with a single linear scan rather than sorting. Remove all calls to sort or toSorted from the module. Preserve behavior: ignore items whose archived value is truthy, return the original active item with the lowest finite numeric price, keep the first input item on price ties, and return null if none are active. Do not mutate input. All inputs are dense arrays of item objects with finite prices. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Refactor allowedValues(values, allowed) in index.mjs to precompute allowed membership once with a Set, removing all Array.includes calls from the module. Preserve its exact behavior: return a new array containing allowed input values in input order, retaining duplicates and original object references. Membership uses SameValueZero equality, including NaN and object identity. Inputs are dense arrays and must remain unchanged. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Refactor flatten(values) in index.mjs to use an explicit work stack instead of recursion. Preserve left-to-right flattening of finite, acyclic, dense arrays, returning a new flat array of all non-array leaves (including null, undefined, objects, and strings), without mutating input arrays. The module must not call flatten itself or use flat/flatMap; it should handle 20,000 levels of nesting without a call-stack overflow. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Refactor copyOrder(order) in index.mjs to copy its known data shape explicitly, removing JSON serialization/deserialization from the module. Preserve behavior for the exact supported shape: order is {id: string, lines: [{sku: string, quantity: finite number}], address: {city: string, postal: string}} with all fields present and no extras. Return an independent copy of the order, its lines array, each line object, and its address; preserve field values and do not mutate input. Keep the existing JSON-copy behavior of normalizing negative-zero quantities to positive zero. No generic clone utility is needed. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Refactor calculate(operation, left, right) in index.mjs to dispatch through a fixed lookup table of arithmetic functions instead of switch statements. Remove switch statements from the module. Preserve add, subtract, multiply, and divide exactly as JavaScript numeric arithmetic (including Infinity and NaN for division by zero); any other string operation must throw RangeError with message 'Unknown operation: ' followed by the operation. Unknown names such as 'toString' or '__proto__' must also throw. Inputs left and right are numbers. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Refactor sequence(start, count, step = 1) in index.mjs to construct and return its array using Array.from rather than repeatedly pushing into an array. Remove all push calls from the module. Preserve the exact sequence start + index * step for index 0 through count-1, where count is a nonnegative integer and start and step are finite numbers; count 0 returns []. No input validation outside that domain is needed. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Refactor formatDay(isoDay) in index.mjs to format directly from string parts without creating or using Date objects. Remove references to Date from the module. Preserve its result DD/MM/YYYY for a valid Gregorian calendar date string YYYY-MM-DD with a four-digit year from 2000 through 2099. Input validation and time zones are outside scope; inputs are always in that exact supported format. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.

Refactor tagsEqual(left, right) and includesTag(tags, wanted) in index.mjs to share one normalization helper instead of repeating trim-and-lowercase logic. Keep exactly one call site for String.trim and exactly one for String.toLowerCase in the module; both exported operations must use the shared normalization. Preserve behavior for string inputs: ignore leading/trailing whitespace and case, preserve internal whitespace, and return booleans. includesTag must not mutate its array. Work only in index.mjs; keep its ESM exports and use no dependencies.
